title: Tamil Nadu Assembly sees TVK walkout and birthday controversy
summary: The Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly witnessed a DMK-led opposition walkout amid heated exchanges between the ruling TVK government and critics. Simultaneously, reports emerged regarding controversies surrounding Chief Minister Joseph Vijay's birthday celebrations.
summary_points: DMK members staged a walkout from the assembly during debates on the Governor's Address.
Chief Minister Joseph Vijay faced allegations over a three-tier cake design placing the state emblem beneath a figurine.
TVK functionaries were criticized for using school premises to host birthday programs.
Reports surfaced regarding the appointment of private aide Jagadish Palanisamy as Private Secretary on taxpayer money.
title_hi: तमिलनाडु विधानसभा में टीवीके का वॉकआउट और जन्माष्टमी की चर्चा
summary_hi: रuling TVK सरकार के साथ-साथ क्रांति डीएमके ने भी सदन से वॉकआउट किया। इसके अलावा, सीएम जोसेफ विजय की जन्माष्टमी पर कई रिपोर्टों में चर्चा हुई है।
summary_points_hi: सीएम के साथ-साथ डीएमके ने भी सदन से वॉकआउट किया।
